title: Chats

empty.title: Start a chat
empty.body: Pick a model and ask anything. You can keep typing while it works.

composer.label: Message
composer.placeholder: Message. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.

pending.note: They reach the model together, in order, at its next step.
pending.afterStop: You stopped the turn. These messages are waiting for you.
pending.afterFailure: The turn ended early. These messages are waiting for you.

refused.resource_unreachable: {{addon}} could not find that resource, or you have no access to it. Nothing was changed.
refused.not_running: {{addon}} is starting or stopped, so nothing was sent. Try again in a moment.

app.title: Interactive view of {{tool}}

notes.compacted: The conversation was compacted to make room ({{before}} to {{after}} tokens).

errors.send: The message could not be sent.
errors.delete: The chat could not be deleted.

confirmDelete.title: Delete {{name}}?
confirmDelete.chat: The chat and its messages are deleted for good.
confirmDelete.agent: Chats that use this agent are kept. Triggers that use it stop working.
confirmDelete.trigger: The trigger stops and its history of runs is deleted.
confirmDelete.skill: The skill is deleted for good.
confirmDelete.mcp: The connector is deleted with its saved token, headers and environment. A saved agent that names it can no longer use it.
confirmDelete.task: The task is deleted. Its jobs stay until their retention passes.
confirmDelete.connector: The connector stops and its settings are deleted.

memoryNotice: Chats are kept in memory only. They are lost when the server restarts.

attach.busy: Files go with a message that starts a turn. Wait for this one to end or stop it.
attach.off: Files are off on this server.
attach.queued: A file sent now waits with its message until the model takes it at its next step.

skillsPage.title: Skills
skillsPage.intro: A skill tells the model how to do one kind of task. Chats list the skills they can use, and the model reads one when a task matches. When two skills have the same name, the nearest one wins.
skillsPage.name: Name

agentsPage.title: Agents
agentsPage.intro: An agent is a saved set of instructions and tools. A chat with an agent gets only what its lists name, and only what you may use at that moment.
agentsPage.name: Name
agentsPage.grants: What a chat with this agent may use. An empty list gives nothing.
agentsPage.mcpHint: Server name from the model's MCP configuration
agentsPage.fixModel: Always use one model (otherwise you choose the model for each chat)
agentsPage.noConnectors: You have no MCP connectors yet.

triggersPage.title: Triggers
triggersPage.intro: A trigger starts a chat as you, by itself: at a time, or when a file arrives in a folder. Each run is an ordinary chat that you can open and undo.
triggersPage.name: Name
triggersPage.noAgentNote: With no agent, a run uses the model and switches of the chat that made it, and no tool that acts at once. Choose an agent to give it more.
triggersPage.proposalsNote: A proposal does nothing until you confirm it.

inbox.pushDenied: Browser notifications are blocked for this site.
inbox.pushUnavailable: This server cannot keep push subscriptions.
inbox.confirmAll_one: Remove {{count}} notification? This cannot be undone.
inbox.confirmAll_other: Remove all {{count}} notifications? This cannot be undone.
inbox.confirmRead_one: Remove {{count}} read notification? Unread ones stay.
inbox.confirmRead_other: Remove {{count}} read notifications? Unread ones stay.
inbox.title: Notifications
inbox.emptyBody: Results of your triggers and connectors appear here, also for work that finished while you were away.
inbox.noFailedBody: Runs and connectors that fail show up here.
inbox.proposalsBody: A model proposed a change. Nothing is saved until you answer.

checkFailed.title: The update check failed
checkFailed.body: Could not check: {{sources}}. The last two automatic checks failed, so updates may be missing from the list.

ops.emptyBody: Installs, updates and removals appear here while they run, and for a day after.

connectorsPage.title: Connections
connectorsPage.intro: A connector links a messaging platform to your chats, so people can talk to one of your agents from there. Each platform comes from a connector add-on.
connectorsPage.noAddonHint: A connector add-on carries the messages of a platform such as Telegram. Install one from the add-on gallery to add a binding.
connectorsPage.waitingText: These bindings are kept, but they do not run until their add-on is installed and turned on.

oauth.disconnectText: LocalAI asks the service to revoke this login and then forgets it. Tools that use this connection stop working until you connect again.
oauth.disconnected: {{name}} is disconnected. The service revoked the login.
oauth.disconnectedNotTold: {{name}} is disconnected here, but the service did not confirm that it revoked the login. Remove the access in your account at the service too.

reason.revoked: The service ended the login, or the access was revoked.
reason.client_rejected: The service no longer accepts the client of this server. An administrator may need to update it.
reason.refused: The service refused to renew the login.
reason.needs_approval: The login of this add-on changed and must be approved again.
reason.credential_rejected: The service refused the access, even after a renewal.
reason.expired: The login expired and cannot be renewed.
reason.write_failed: The renewed login could not be saved.
reason.unreadable: The saved login could not be read.
reason.scopes_missing: The service no longer grants all the access this add-on needs. Connect again and allow it.
reason.endpoint_changed: The add-on now sends logins to another address of the service, so this login cannot move with it. Connect again.
reason.token_too_large: The service renewed the login with an access token larger than LocalAI can use (4096 bytes).

oauth.approvalUser: An administrator must approve this add-on first.
oauth.approvalUserChanged: The login of this add-on changed. An administrator must approve it again.
oauth.approvalAdmin: Nobody can connect until you approve the login of this add-on.
oauth.approvalAdminChanged: The login of this add-on changed since it was approved. Review it and approve it again.

returned.denied: You declined at the service. Nothing changed.

error.invalid_state: The login could not be finished: it expired, or another login started in this browser. Connect again.
error.provider_error: The service reported an error. Try again later.
error.exchange_failed: The service did not complete the login. Connect again.
error.scopes_missing: The service did not grant all the access this add-on needs. Connect again and allow it.
error.unavailable: The add-on could not be reached. Try again later.
error.unknown: The login could not be finished. Connect again.
error.token_too_large: The service issued an access token larger than LocalAI can use (4096 bytes), so the login was not saved. An administrator may need to change how the service issues tokens for this client.

errors.baseUrlRequired: This server does not know its public address, so it cannot send you to the service. Ask an administrator to set the external base URL of the server.
errors.needsApproval: An administrator must approve this add-on first.
errors.approvalStale: The login of this add-on changed. Reload the page.
errors.unavailable: The add-on could not be reached. Try again later.
errors.tooManyLogins: Too many logins were started. Finish the one in the other tab, or wait a few minutes and try again.

add.name: Name
add.hint: A name you recognize, such as Work or Personal. After you add the connection, select Connect to log in to your account.
add.failed: The connection could not be added. Try again.
add.added: {{name}} is added. Select Connect to log in to your account.
add.empty: No connections yet. Add one, then connect your account.

login.hint: A name you recognize, such as Work or Personal. You go to the service to log in next.

duplicate.text: This bot is also connected as {{name}}. Both connections will answer the same message.

connectorsPage.newMenu: Choose the platform of the new connection

share.label: Share
share.intro: People you add can use this connection in their own chats and agents. They see its name and state, never its token or its settings. Messages to the bot still reach your agent.
share.roleUseHelp: Can use it in their chats and agents. Cannot see the token, change it or share it.

shared.title: Shared with you
shared.text: Other people let you use these connections in your chats and agents. Only their owner can change them.

connectorsPage.introAccounts: Accounts you connect once so your chats and agents can use them as tools. Each account comes from an add-on.
connectorsPage.noAddonAccountsHint: An account add-on connects a service to your chats and agents. Install one from the add-on gallery to add a connection.
connectorsPage.noAddonMessagingHint: A messaging add-on carries the messages of a chat platform. Install one from the add-on gallery to add a binding.

conversionPage.title: Converted from the old chat
conversionPage.intro: The old chat, agents, tasks and skills were converted when this server started. Triggers are switched off until you turn them on. Connectors are not converted: add the bot again in the Connectors page. A chat keeps what was said, not what the model remembered.
conversionPage.notRun: No conversion has run on this server.

tools.grantSensitive: Sensitive: this changes what the agent may do or reach later.
tools.fallbackBuiltin: {{addon}} replaces {{tool}} but cannot serve this chat now (stopped, switched off here or not granted): the built-in {{tool}} serves.
tools.fallbackNone: {{addon}} replaces {{tool}} but cannot serve this chat now, and the built-in {{tool}} is off: this chat has no {{tool}}.

commands.title: Commands can't run here
commands.none: No add-on that runs code is installed, so the assistant can write files but cannot run scripts or commands.
commands.askFix: Ask an administrator to fix it.
commands.chipTitle: This chat cannot run code or commands. Select for details.
commands.hostChipTitle: Commands in this chat run on this machine, not isolated. Select for details.
commands.providerHost: Commands run on the server without isolation.
commands.unknown: Execution readiness or isolation is unknown.

unknownBy.owner_unreachable: Execution readiness or isolation is unknown: the add-on owner could not be reached.

unknownBy.stale: Execution readiness or isolation is unknown: the status did not match the add-on's current version.
unknownBy.invalid_status: Execution readiness or isolation is unknown: the add-on sent a status the host could not accept.

commands.providerUnavailable: The selected execution provider is unavailable.
commands.disabled: Running commands is switched off for this chat.

hostOff.reason: The server's built-in bash is off, so the assistant can write files but cannot run scripts or commands.
hostOff.whoAdmin: You are an administrator. In Settings, Tools, turn on the Commands (bash) row. Ask each time is the safer choice. Commands then run on the server without isolation and can read what the server can read.
hostOff.whoMember: Ask an administrator of this server to turn it on.
hostOff.sandboxText: For isolated commands, install an add-on that runs commands in isolation instead.

consent.title: Run this command on this machine?
consent.body: Commands run on this machine with no isolation. They can read files that LocalAI can read and reach the internet and your network.
consent.alwaysHint: Always on this instance lets every user's chats run commands here without asking (Settings > Tools).
consent.askAdmin: Only an administrator can allow commands on this machine. Ask one, or run the command yourself.
consent.job: This starts a background job. It keeps running after this call, and allowing it also allows the input the model writes to it later, without asking again.
consent.expired: Not answered: the turn that asked has ended, so the command did not run.

describe.shell: Lets the model run shell commands and scripts.
describe.files: Lets the model list, read, write and search your files.
describe.web: Lets the model search the web and read public pages.
describe.media: Lets the model describe images and transcribe recordings from your files.
describe.collections: Lets the model search your collections.
describe.subagents: Lets the model start a sub-agent for one task and get its report.
describe.saved_agents: Lets the model start one of your saved agents as a sub-agent.
describe.triggers: Lets the model propose, list, change and delete triggers. You confirm each new trigger or change.
describe.changes: Lets the model propose edits to your notes, its rules, skills, pages and dashboard. You confirm each one.
describe.memory: The model can read your notes before it answers and save new ones. Turn it off to make this a private chat: nothing is read from your notes or saved to them. Your other chats are not affected.
describe.history: Lets the model search and read your earlier chats.
describe.localai_client: Lets the model make images, speech, sound and video, and transcribe, embed, rerank and detect, with the models installed here.
describe.localai_admin: Lets the model manage this server: models, backends, settings and the state. For administrators; it asks you before it changes anything.

whenOff.shell: The model can write files but cannot run anything.
whenOff.files: The model cannot see or change your files.
whenOff.web: The model cannot look anything up online.
whenOff.media: The model cannot read images or recordings itself.
whenOff.collections: The model cannot read your collections.
whenOff.saved_agents: The model cannot see or start your saved agents.
whenOff.triggers: The model cannot propose or manage triggers.
whenOff.changes: The model cannot propose edits to your notes, its rules, skills, pages or dashboard.
whenOff.memory: This is a private chat. The model neither reads nor saves your notes.
whenOff.history: The model cannot see your earlier chats.
whenOff.localai_client: The model cannot run these models itself.
whenOff.localai_admin: The model cannot manage this server.

tools.addonDescribe_one: Gives the model {{count}} tool from this add-on.
tools.addonDescribe_other: Gives the model {{count}} tools from this add-on.
tools.serverDescribe: An MCP server of the model: its tools are offered to the model.
tools.connectorDescribe: One of your MCP connectors: its tools are offered to the model.
tools.gone: Not available here any more. Switch it off to remove it.

connection.label: Connections
connection.help: Choose the connections this chat may use. The assistant can only use the ones you tick.
connection.helpMany: The assistant names the connection in each action, and can only name a ticked one.
connection.sole: This is your only connection, so it is used.
connection.choose: Choose at least one connection to use these tools
connection.byAgent: The agent of this chat sets the connections. Change them on the agent.
connection.agentLabel: Connections for chats of this agent
connection.agentHelp: Chats of this agent may use only these connections and cannot change them.
connection.perChatHelp: None chosen: each chat chooses its own.

messaging.title: Messaging apps
messaging.intro: These apply to chats that start in a messaging app. The connection must allow the same thing on its own permissions page.

unattended.title: When nobody is watching
unattended.intro: These apply to runs that a trigger or a messaging app starts, where nobody can confirm a step.

memory_write.title: Remember things
memory_write.description: Lets the model propose a note for your memory or the agent's own. You confirm each note.

profile_write.title: Change its own rules
profile_write.description: Lets the model propose an edit to the agent's standing rules. You confirm each edit.

skills_write.title: Write skills
skills_write.description: Lets the model propose a new or changed skill. You confirm each one.

pages_write.title: Create pages
pages_write.description: Lets the model propose a small app that opens in a sandboxed frame. You confirm it.

dashboard_write.title: Change the dashboard
dashboard_write.description: Lets the model propose a new layout for your Home dashboard. You confirm each change.

knowledge_write.title: Add to knowledge
knowledge_write.description: Lets the model propose a text for a collection of your Knowledge. You confirm each one; it is never added at once.

triggers_propose.title: Also propose from messaging apps
triggers_propose.description: Lets the model propose a trigger when someone asks in a messaging app. You confirm it.

triggers_run.title: Let triggers start from messaging apps
triggers_run.description: Lets a trigger tied to a messaging connection start a run and deliver its result there.

talkback_channels.title: Reply on known channels
talkback_channels.description: Lets the model send a message to a channel it already talks in.

talkback_new_channel.title: Start new channels
talkback_new_channel.description: Lets the model start a conversation on a channel it has not used before.

files_upload.title: Receive files from messaging apps
files_upload.description: Lets senders attach files for the model to read. It cannot send files out.

act_files.title: Write files on its own
act_files.description: Lets a run nobody is watching write files in the agent's folders.

act_addons.title: Use add-on actions on its own
act_addons.description: Lets a run nobody is watching call the actions of the agent's add-ons.

act_send.title: Send messages on its own
act_send.description: Lets a run nobody is watching send messages beyond its delivery target.

act_spend.title: Use paid or external tools on its own
act_spend.description: Lets a run nobody is watching use paid or external tools and the network.

history_read.title: Read your earlier chats
history_read.description: Lets the model search and read your earlier chats. An agent that works in a folder reads only the chats of its own.

mcpPage.title: MCP connectors
mcpPage.supporting: Connect MCP servers to give your chats and agents more tools, such as search or your own APIs.
mcpPage.forbidden: MCP is not available to your account.

memoryPage.over: Over the cap: the end is not sent to the model.
memoryPage.tooBig: Too long: shorten it to save.
memoryPage.clearAsk_one: Delete {{count}} file? It moves to the Trash and you can restore it from Files.
memoryPage.clearAsk_other: Delete {{count}} files? They move to the Trash and you can restore them from Files.

tabs.label: Notes of
tabs.channelsNote: Notes saved from chats in messaging apps. Open a note to read it, or delete it. A note from a sender who is not verified with you always waits for your OK.
tabs.clearAgent: Delete the notes of this agent

memoryPage.deletedNote: These agents were deleted. Their notes stay until you delete them here.

triggerActs.help: A run starts by itself, so nobody is there to approve a step. It can read and report. Tick what it may also do. It never gets more than its agent holds.
triggerActs.noAgent: No agent is chosen, so only what you tick limits it.
triggerActs.canActText_one: A run may use {{count}} kind of action without asking.
triggerActs.canActText_other: A run may use {{count}} kinds of action without asking.
triggerActs.addonRow: A run may use the actions of the add-on {{id}}.
triggerActs.blocked: Your agent does not hold this, so it cannot be ticked. Add it to the agent first.
triggerActs.unused: Your agent does not hold this, so a run does not use it.
triggerActs.unusedList: Listed, but not used because the agent does not hold it: {{names}}.
triggerActs.writesNote: Its plan names the file {{file}}, so a run may also write files.

why.no_acts: No permission to act is set, so its runs only read and report.
why.agent: Its agent does not hold the permissions it asks for, so its runs only read and report.
why.declared: It was set up to read and report only. Nothing ticked here changes that.
why.binding: A connection in read only mode made it. Nothing ticked here changes that.

memorySettings.ledeOn: Your chats keep short notes about you and read them before they answer. Turn it off to stop reading and saving everywhere. Your notes stay where they are.
memorySettings.ledeOff: Nothing is read from your notes or saved to them, in any chat or agent. The assistant says that memory is off if you ask it to remember something. Your notes stay, and you can still read, export and delete them.
memorySettings.unavailable: Notes are files, and files are off on this server, so memory cannot work here.
memorySettings.saveLede: What happens when the assistant wants to keep something. The strictest rule always wins.

ask.title: Ask me first
ask.body: A card waits in the chat. You confirm, edit or dismiss it.

auto.title: Save it and tell me
auto.body: In your own chats the note is saved at once. The chat shows "Saved to memory" with an Undo. Up to 5 notes a reply. A long note, or one that looks like a secret, still waits for you.

always.title: Always confirm
always.body: Like Ask me first, and nothing can loosen it. Undo and forget also wait for you. No agent or messaging setting can override it.

never.title: Never
never.body: The assistant cannot save notes. It tells you that saving is off.

memorySettings.saveNote: Background runs and triggers never save a note. A saved agent can ask more, never less, than you chose here.

messaging.title: In messaging apps
messaging.lede: What happens when a note is proposed in a chat from a messaging app, where the sender may not be you.

ask.title: Ask me first
ask.body: The bot asks in the chat: "Reply yes to save it." A listed sender can answer there. Others wait for you in the app.

paired_private.title: Save it for a verified person in a private chat
paired_private.body: Saved at once only when the sender is a verified person and the chat is one-to-one. The note goes to that conversation, with an Undo. A note that looks like a secret still waits.

never.title: Never
never.body: No notes are saved from messaging apps.

messaging.limit: Never looser than the setting above.
messaging.lockedAlways: Your setting above is Always confirm, so this row cannot save a note at once.
messaging.lockedNever: Your setting above is Never, so no note is saved from a messaging app.

memorySettings.loadError: Could not load your memory settings.
memorySettings.notesLede: Read, edit, export or delete them. This works while memory is off.

memoryOff.title: Memory is off here.

line.chat: This is a private chat: nothing is read or saved. Your notes are untouched. Turn it on in the Tools menu.
line.user: No chat or agent reads or saves notes, and your notes are untouched.
line.agent: The agent of this chat has memory switched off.
line.files: Notes are files, and files are off on this server.
line.provider: The add-on that serves memory is not available, so nothing is read or saved. Pick a provider in Settings, Memory.

memoryOff.userRow: Off in your settings. Turn it on in Settings, Memory.

agentMemory.title: Memory
agentMemory.lede: Choose which notes this agent reads and where it saves new ones.
agentMemory.offUser: Memory is off in your settings, so this choice has no effect until you turn it on.

mine_and_own.title: Mine and its own
mine_and_own.body: Reads your notes and its own. Saves only to its own.

own.title: Its own only
own.body: Reads and saves only its own notes. Your notes stay out of reach.

agentMemory.mineWarn: This agent can add notes to your memory, for every chat. You confirm each one.

asBefore.title: As before
asBefore.body: This agent was saved before this choice existed. It reads your notes when its add-ons list names Memory, and the model picks where a note is saved. Pick one of the choices below to change that.

agentMemory.copyNote: Exporting an agent, or importing it as a new one, keeps this choice and never copies its notes.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.ask: This agent has notes of its own ({{count}}). What should happen to them?
delete.legend: What to do with the notes

keep.title: Keep the notes
keep.body: They stay on the Memory page under Deleted agents until you delete them.

export.title: Export, then delete
export.body: Download the notes as a zip file, then move them to the Trash.

delete.title: Delete the notes too
delete.body: They move to the Trash and you can restore them from Files.

rule.title: When it wants to save a note

use_mine.title: Use my setting
use_mine.body: Your setting is {{level}}. Change it in Settings > Memory.

auto.title: Save it and tell me
auto.body: Saves each note at once and tells you in the chat, with an Undo, even when your setting is Ask me first. A long note, or one that looks like a secret, still waits.

rule.hint: In a messaging chat a note goes to that conversation first, and reaches this agent's own notes only from a verified person. Saving at once in a messaging chat applies only to a verified person in a one-to-one chat.
rule.offReason: The save level does not apply while memory is off.
rule.readsReason: The save level does not apply: this agent reads notes but cannot save any.

level.title: How much it does with notes

reads.title: Reads notes
reads.body: Uses your notes to answer. Never saves any.

saves.title: Reads and saves notes
saves.body: Uses notes and saves new ones, as your save level allows.

agentMemory.whoseOff: Memory is off for this agent, so there are no notes to choose from.

providerPicker.title: Provider
providerPicker.lede: One provider serves at a time. Your existing data stays where it is when you switch.
providerPicker.loadError: The providers could not be loaded
providerPicker.saveFailed: The provider could not be changed
providerPicker.failedReason: This stays off until you pick a provider. Nothing moved to the built-in provider, so nothing is saved where you did not choose.

memory.builtinBody: Plain files in your Memory folder. Nothing leaves this machine.
memory.offBody: Nothing is read, offered, saved or sent. Existing notes are kept.

forget.lede: Ask {{name}} to forget the notes it keeps for you. Your files in the Memory folder are not touched.
forget.confirmBody: {{name}} will be asked to forget every note it keeps for you. It may hold the change until you confirm it on the Add-ons page.
forget.confirmBodyFinal: {{name}} will be asked to forget every note it keeps for you. This cannot be undone.
forget.waiting: The change waits for your confirmation on the Add-ons page

sandboxProfile.label: Sandbox profile
sandboxProfile.notAllowed: Your administrator has not given you this profile
sandboxProfile.absent: This release has no image for it
sandboxProfile.draft: The new chat starts in {{title}}. Pick a profile here, or change it later in the chat.

source.chat: This chat runs in {{title}}, your choice.
source.agent: This chat runs in {{title}}, set by its agent.
source.default: This chat runs in {{title}}, the default.

sandboxProfile.switchWarning: Switching restarts the sandbox. Your files stay. Running processes and installed packages are lost.
sandboxProfile.failed: The {{title}} image could not be prepared: {{error}}
sandboxProfile.fallback: {{title}} could not be used, so commands run in {{base}}.
sandboxProfile.newerImage: A newer image is available. It applies when the sandbox restarts.
sandboxProfile.notAllowedError: You may not use this profile.
sandboxProfile.saveError: The profile could not be changed.

admin.title: Sandbox profiles
admin.intro: A profile is an environment with its own programs. Everyone may use every profile until you limit one.
admin.limits: {{cpus}} CPUs, {{memory}} MiB of memory, {{disk}} MiB of disk
admin.baseAlways: Every user may use Base. It is the profile that runs when another one cannot.
admin.restricted: Only the roles and users below
admin.noPrevious: There is no previous image yet
admin.memory: Memory cap of a sandbox, in MiB
admin.disk: Disk cap of a sandbox, in MiB
admin.quotaHelp: A cap lowers the limit of a profile and never raises it. Leave a field empty for no cap.
admin.badQuota: Use a whole number of MiB, or leave the field empty.
admin.ownerError: Owner settings are unavailable or changed: {{message}}
admin.loadError: The sandbox profiles could not be read.

harness.title: The context window of this model is too small for the chat

admin.reason: It is {{window}} tokens and the chat needs at least {{minimum}}; {{recommended}} is better.
admin.checking: Checking whether {{target}} tokens fit in this machine's memory…
admin.fits: {{target}} tokens fit in this machine's memory (about {{need}}).
admin.fitsLess: {{recommended}} tokens do not fit in this machine's memory. {{target}} do (about {{need}}).
admin.unknown: The memory this needs could not be estimated.
admin.none: Not even {{minimum}} tokens fit in this machine's memory. Pick a smaller model.

user.reason: It is {{window}} tokens and the chat needs at least {{minimum}}.
user.switch: Switch this chat to an installed model with a larger window.
user.askAdmin: No installed model you can use has a large enough window. Ask an administrator to raise it or to install another model.

chat.title: The context size of this chat is too small
chat.reason: The setting of this chat is {{window}} tokens and the chat needs at least {{minimum}}.
chat.fix: Use the window of the model
